result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, with consistent card styling, clear hierarchy, and no overlapping or misaligned elements. The main visual defect is the low-contrast promo banner, where white text sits on a pale mint background and is nearly unreadable. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded per the instructions.

issues.description: The promo banner's heading '3 free deliveries for you' and its subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are white on a very pale mint green background. The contrast ratio is far below WCAG AA, so the offer code and minimum order details are barely legible.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text to a dark color (e.g., near-black or dark green) or use a darker banner background so the heading and code text meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
